summary: GCL Global Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K on August 7, 2026, announcing the adjournment of its Extraordinary General Meeting (EGM) to December 1, 2026, to further consider a proposed share consolidation. The company concluded the consolidation may not be necessary while assessing Nasdaq listing requirements. Proxies submitted before the original meeting remain valid; new proxy deadline extended to November 27, 2026. The filing is a routine procedural update regarding a shareholder meeting adjournment, not a special-situation event. No deal terms, pricing, or strategic alternatives are disclosed.
